task: Reproduce UX-002: Measure /chat overflow at 390×844 viewport

results.root_cause: <main> grid child has min-width: auto (CSS Grid default). Missing min-width: 0 — the `class="p-0"` lacks `min-w-0`. Content intrinsic width > 390px forces grid item expansion.

clipped_actionable_elements.status: MARGINAL — fits but has no breathing room
OVERFLOWING — textarea visible but container overflows

results.masking: body { overflow-x: hidden } prevents scrollbar but content is visually cropped

fix_recommendation: Add `min-w-0` Tailwind class to `<main>` element (change `class="p-0"` to `class="p-0 min-w-0"`). Grid parent already has correct width (390px); `min-width: 0` on the grid item prevents expansion beyond the grid column.
